learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge and practical skills for working with AutoCAD software for creating and editing electrical drawings.
Acquire basic skills for working with AutoCAD through practically oriented training.
Acquire practical skills for preparing and making electrical drawings independently.

syllabus_topics: Understanding the interface of the program AutoCAD. Menus.
Operating modes SNAP, GRID, ORTHO, OSNAP, OTRACK, POLAR.
Drawing of straight and curved objects.
Working with layers. Creating and managing layers.
Working with blocks. Creation, insertion, editing and adding attributes.
Creating and using libraries of 2D electrical symbols and units.
Common rules for presentation and preparation of a drawing for printing.
teaching_methods: Theoretical part presentation at the beginning of each exercise

assessment_methods.method: Validation of acquired practical skills for work with AutoCAD

assessment_rules: Assessment is continuous. The final grade for the course is determined by the acceptance of course assignments and the validation of acquired practical skills for work with AutoCAD, conducted in non-class time.
